messages:
Kira (Support): @Maya quick escalation — Helios Labs trial (4 seats) showing intermittent SSO 401s and missing events in the realtime feed. trial ends in 6 days, flagged for renewal risk. ticket #84377 opened :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): thanks Kira. drop the last error and the Helios contact so we can set a priority handoff. we'll do a warm intro + enablement runbook. :eyes:
Kira (Support): latest errors from logs:
```
2025-07-21T13:22:01Z ERROR Auth: 401 Unauthorized - invalid_refresh_token (tenant: helios-labs)
2025-07-21T13:22:34Z WARN Ingest: missing batch seq 214 -> replay pending
TraceID: helios-84377
```
Contact: emma@helioslabs.com (Head of Data). They've attempted setup twice; reported gaps during a demo. ops-bot: traces & dashboard -> https://internal.redwood/logs/84377 and https://dash.redwood/tenant/helios/84377 :link:
Maya (CS): proposed triage (short): 1) 15m warm intro today to confirm consent and scope 2) hands-on enablement tomorrow to regen creds, validate SSO, and run a targeted backfill 3) short-term mitigation: pause webhook retries and enable queued replay job. If backfill errors, escalate to eng-oncall. Who can lead the enablement? :calendar:
Luis (Solutions): I can lead the enablement tomorrow at 11:00 PT. I'll prepare curl + Postman snippets and a minimal rollback (polling) plan.
Nina (Onboarding): I'll own the runbook edits and capture permission steps for token regen. can join the call and take notes.
Kira (Support): Emma is available 4pm PT today for the 15m sync. I'll attempt token regen after consent and post creds via vault link.
Maya (CS): perfect — I'll send the warm intro now and create 2 calendar invites (sync + enablement). Owners: @Luis / @Nina / @Kira. Deliverables: 1) customer-facing summary after enablement 2) renewal risk update and CS score by Friday EOD.
Luis (Solutions): quick checklist I'll include in the invite:
- verify SSO metadata + client_id
- regen service token (least privilege)
- run backfill for seq 210-220
- monitor ingestion lag for 30m
If backfill fails, collect traceID and escalate.
Maya (CS): if manual backfill is >2h impact, we'll propose a temporary credit or usage adjustment to preserve renewals — capture approval in the summary. eng-oncall: please standby for escalation if backfill hits 5xxs.
eng-oncall: acknowledged. if pinged, include trace link and any job logs.
Kira (Support): adding ticket link and short notes to the invite. Closing loop here unless others chime in :thumbsup:
